item.title: Hanahira!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Fuguriya, Yurin Yurin
  • 発売日: 2010-09-25
  • スコア: 5.3100000000000005/10 (612 人評価)
  • 日本語名: はなひらっ！
  • 英語名: Hanahira!

あらすじ

The story revolves around four girls who attend Saint Michael Girls’ School and highlights all their cute dokidoki yuriyuri love for one another during and after school. The story is quite lighthearted and follows the four girls at school, shopping, hanging around and coming together for a pajama party.

[from Micchi’s review]
